subject.title: feat: add exact-turn capability projection reports

question: Should OpenClaw core own a narrowed capability-projection CLI built from canonical effective inventory and uniquely identified trajectory turns?
rationale: The linked issue is explicitly waiting on product and security direction, and the current branch creates a substantial parallel audit contract rather than a thin view over existing owner surfaces.

options.title: Sponsor a thin canonical report
options.body: Approve the feature after it uses a unique turn identity and canonical effective-tool inventory as its authority.

options.title: Sponsor the broader proposed model
options.body: Accept long-term ownership of the independent capability taxonomy, schema, auxiliary-evidence contract, and publication semantics after correctness fixes.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause or close the branch until a real operator workflow demonstrates that current trajectory and tool-inventory diagnostics are insufficient.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a thin canonical report
recommendation.body: Approve the feature after it uses a unique turn identity and canonical effective-tool inventory as its authority.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses trajectory, agent-tool inventory, CLI, and security boundaries rather than belonging to one narrow implementation owner.
